technical_summary: POC run on Dedicated staging with a reserved 8-GPU pool (H100-equivalent). Workload: multi-turn support bot + document rerank. We exercised continuous batching, KV prefix caching, and model variant fallback. Key metrics captured: tokens/sec, end-to-end p50/p95 latencies, GPU utilization, and observed cold-start times for new model versions.
poc_results: Peak sustained throughput: ~9,500 tokens/sec across 8 GPUs with batching tuned to 8
Representative p95 latency: 280ms for 128-token responses (end-to-end from request to first-chunk stream), p50 ~90ms
Concurrent sessions: sustained 1,200 conversational sessions (avg response length 100–150 tokens) with <1% error rate
Soak (12h): no memory leaks, KV cache steady-state ~32-36% hit rate leading to 18% reduction in token compute compared to cold baseline
Autoscaling/burst: validated ability to add 2 additional GPUs for 30-minute bursts via Dedicated burst policy
Model fallback: verified automatic downgrade to quantized variant increased throughput by 2.6x at expense of minor quality regression (acceptable for low-priority reranking path)
